record: primary local model, candidate decision and corrected threshold selection
status_meaning: family B, a separate local head model, not a shared-encoder PulseClassify model
the corrected deployed-rule gate passes, so it is eligible to ship once the production configuration is frozen
the test split remains locked and unread

model.head: primary
model.form: TF-IDF plus logistic regression, one head, native runtime, no ONNX Runtime and no tokenizer
model.undeclared_heads_route_to: existing configured engine (topic, signal, whyKey, category, field)

routing.decision: explicit per-head architecture decision, recorded here and in the manifest
routing.score: raw decision value from the linear classifier
routing.consequence: ECE is measured and reported for transparency and is not blocking, because no probability is consumed as confidence

phase_1_classifier_level.metric: positive-class F1 under an open rule
phase_1_classifier_level.result: passed, so the candidate was eligible to proceed

old_threshold_invalidated.selected_by: precision-only procedure, which is no longer permitted

corrected_threshold_selection.procedure: routing mode first, then cross-fitted selection over a training-side pool, highest coverage among thresholds satisfying every applicable constraint, confirmed on a held-out half, frozen, then validation read once

selection_pool.cross_fitting: 5-fold, vectorizer and classifier refitted per fold, raw decision scores, so no row is scored by a model fitted on it

corrected_threshold_selection.objective: highest coverage among the feasible thresholds

calibration_ece_0_05.status: informational: empirical threshold routing was explicitly selected for this head, so probabilities are not consumed as confidence
calibration_ece_0_05.not_silently_waived: under probability-based routing this same number would be blocking

gate_status.verdict: all applicable constraints pass on the frozen deployed rule, evaluated once on validation

honest_caveats: the chosen threshold maximises coverage, so it sits on the precision boundary: the held-out half scored 0.8842 against a 0.90 floor while the selection half and validation scored 0.9016 and 0.9130
the three precision estimates disagree by about three points, which is the same heterogeneity seen before between periods
calibration remains uncalibrated at ECE 0.3266 and is not blocking only because of the recorded mode decision
not_done: the test split has not been opened and stays locked at 148 ids
the production configuration is not frozen
